name: timeline-project-tools
description: Inspect, preview, edit and render supplied portable Timeline Studio projects. Runs on the user's Anna Agent host; no live browser bridge, cloud project access or AI generation.

tools.name: timeline_project_inspect
tools.description: Inspect a user-provided local .timeline archive before editing; returns revision, tracks, duration and media inventory. Does not access the open Anna window or its private cloud storage.

parameters.name: project
parameters.description: Absolute path to a user-provided .timeline archive on this Agent host

tools.name: timeline_track_inspect
tools.description: Inspect clips on one track in the supplied .timeline archive.

parameters.name: project
parameters.description: Absolute path to a user-provided .timeline archive on this Agent host

parameters.name: track
parameters.description: Track ID returned by project inspection; inspect before choosing a track

tools.name: timeline_clip_inspect
tools.description: Inspect one clip by stable ID in the supplied archive.

parameters.name: project
parameters.description: Absolute path to a user-provided .timeline archive on this Agent host

parameters.name: clipId
parameters.description: Stable clip ID returned by track/project inspection, never a display name

tools.name: timeline_marker_inspect
tools.description: Inspect annotations without changing rendered duration.

parameters.name: project
parameters.description: Absolute path to a user-provided .timeline archive on this Agent host

parameters.name: markerId
parameters.description: Optional stable marker ID; omit to inspect all annotations

tools.name: timeline_transcript_inspect
tools.description: Read existing transcript/caption associations; does not transcribe audio.

parameters.name: project
parameters.description: Absolute path to a user-provided .timeline archive on this Agent host

parameters.name: audioClipId
parameters.description: Optional audio clip ID; omit to inspect all existing transcripts

tools.name: timeline_project_diff
tools.description: After project inspection, validate operations and return semantic changes plus a short-lived previewId. No files written. Use stable operation IDs and review the returned changes before apply.

parameters.name: project
parameters.description: Absolute path to a user-provided .timeline archive on this Agent host

parameters.name: baseRevision
parameters.description: Exact nonnegative revision returned by the latest project inspection

parameters.name: operations
parameters.description: Ordered shared-registry operations, each with a unique stable id and supported type; preview before applying

tools.name: timeline_project_apply
tools.description: Apply the exact inspected and previewed operations to a NEW archive. Requires previewId from this running session and matching source bytes and revision; never overwrites inputs or existing outputs.

parameters.name: project
parameters.description: Absolute path to a user-provided .timeline archive on this Agent host

parameters.name: baseRevision
parameters.description: Exact nonnegative revision returned by the latest project inspection

parameters.name: operations
parameters.description: Ordered shared-registry operations, each with a unique stable id and supported type; preview before applying

parameters.name: outputProject
parameters.description: Absolute path for a NEW .timeline archive; existing files are rejected

parameters.name: previewId
parameters.description: Single-use receipt from project_diff in this process, valid for 15 minutes

tools.name: timeline_project_render
tools.description: After inspection, render only the documented headless subset to a NEW MP4 using installed FFmpeg/ffprobe. Unsupported composition fails explicitly. No browser AI or live-window rendering.

parameters.name: project
parameters.description: Absolute path to a user-provided .timeline archive on this Agent host

parameters.name: outputVideo
parameters.description: Absolute path for a NEW .mp4 artifact; existing files are rejected

parameters.name: render
parameters.description: Optional headless render settings; rich browser composition is unsupported
